name: Epistles
overview: The Epistles, as evidenced in Luke's writings to Theophilus and the letters sent by the early church, serve as ordered, eyewitness testimonies and authoritative communications to instruct believers with certainty. Luke emphasizes the careful compilation of the gospel message to confirm the truth of Christ's life and teachings, while the letter recorded in Acts 15 demonstrates the apostles and elders actively guiding Gentile believers through written correspondence. These writings affirm the foundational role of epistolary communication in establishing and nurturing the early church's faith and doctrine.
